name: Παραλία Έδεμ
round1Evidence: Deck chairs/parasols and bars available; hotel rents sunbeds (~15€/person, 2023), rest of beach free with free toilets/showers.

name: Γαλάζια Ακτή
round1Evidence: Beach bar with sunbeds; entrance/sunbed pricing quoted (weekday minimum consumption 3€, sunbed 2.50€). Note: sources reference both Lagonisi and Schinias 'Galazia Akti' — both organized.

name: Κεντρική παραλία Σαρωνίδας
round1Evidence: Central Saronida beach has 'umbrellas placed by the municipality'; the named beach bars (Alexander, Mavro Lithari) are on adjacent beaches, not the central one.

name: Σουβάλα
round1Evidence: Souvala beach offers sunbeds, umbrellas, a beach bar and restaurant; nearby Loura beach also organized with umbrellas/sunbeds.

name: Αυλάκι
round1Evidence: Small pebble beach with cement sunbathing platform; umbrellas-sunbeds plus coffee/drinks/food provided by Castello housed directly above the beach.

name: Λιμνιώνας
round1Evidence: Undeveloped and quiet overall, but 'σε ένα μόνο μικρό τμήμα υπάρχουν ξαπλώστρες' and there is a small snack-bar.

name: Κομπονάδα
round1Evidence: In summer the beach has a canteen and sunbeds on one section ('διαθέτει καντίνα και ξαπλώστρες σε ένα κομμάτι της').

name: Μικρή Ζωγεριά
round1Evidence: Zogeria bay, NW Spetses, has two coves; guides (argosaronikos.gr, travelgo) place the taverna and the rented umbrella/sunbed sets (10€/σετ) in the bay, with the small cove specifically holding the taverna and sunbeds. Caveat: some sources describe the bay as a whole, so attribution to the small cove is good but not airtight.

name: Παραλία Πόρτο Γερμενό
round1Evidence: Mostly free beach, but a small part is organized with umbrellas and loungers and the Punda Loca beach bar maintains loungers with umbrellas on the beach.

name: Άγιος Αντώνιος
round1Evidence: psahno.com (local Psachna Evia guide): 'Η παραλία είναι οργανωμένη με ομπρέλες, ξαπλώστρες' with cafeterias, beach bars and tavernas; some boilerplate-reuse risk noted.

name: Άγιος Μηνάς
round1Evidence: eviagreece: organized beach 3km from Chalkida offering umbrellas with loungers or cafes, popular with families; many tavernas/restaurants around.

name: Ζέφυρος
round1Evidence: Disambiguated from the Rhodes namesake: Zefiros is the cafe/beach bar ON the Nea Artaki beach (eviagreece.gr item, e-chalkida video 'Παραλία Ζέφυρος - Νέα Αρτάκη'). Sources on the Nea Artaki beachfront describe beachfront bars with umbrellas and sunbeds (extra charge for sunbeds on weekends), with Zefiros named as the beachfront venue at this spot.

name: Παραλία Δάφνης
round1Evidence: Disambiguated to Dafni Nerotrivias (west-coast central Evia, matches pin 38.63/23.49; the other Dafni is at Chiliadou on the Aegean side). eviaportal's beach-specific page: a seasonal 'beach bar με εστιατόριο' operates on the first section and 'βγάζει μερικές ομπρέλες' when open, plus a taverna on the second section — but it advises bringing your own gear and never mentions ξαπλώστρες. Beach bar confirmed; sunbeds unconfirmed and organization is partial/seasonal.

name: Παραλία Κρύας Βρύσης
round1Evidence: North-Evia (Agia Anna extension) Krya Vrysi is described as 'οργανωμένη με ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες' with a shop on the beach serving coffee/ouzo; note there is also a Krya Vrysi near Karystos.

name: Παραλία Φάρου
round1Evidence: Official bathing-water profile for Faros Avlidas: 'Τμήμα της παραλίας είναι οργανωμένο και διαθέτει... ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες' — assuming our Paralia Farou is the Avlida one (lighthouse at NE end).

name: Σουβάλα
round1Evidence: Disambiguated from the Aegina namesake: our pin matches Πλαζ Σουβάλα at Chalkida's north port (YouTube 'Χαλκίδα Παραλία (Πλαζ Σουβάλα)', egnomi coverage, official bathing-water profile GRBW079155162). The bathing-water profile states part of the beach is organized with permanent umbrellas, showers and bins (municipal-style). No sunbed-rental or beach-bar evidence.

name: Τσοκαΐτι
round1Evidence: eviagreece: Tsokaiti (Istiaia) has 'organized areas with loungers'; in earlier years canteens and beach bars provided loungers and umbrellas — present-tense sunbeds claimed, bar status uncertain.
